description: This PHP class 'ReverseContainer' provides functionality to retrieve service IDs from a dependency injection container, specifically for public services. It includes methods for getting service IDs, recording container services, and generating service ID hashes.

classes.name: ReverseContainer
classes.description: A final class that manages reverse lookup of service IDs in a dependency injection container, supporting both Drupal and Symfony container implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ReverseContainer with a service container, binding a closure to search for services.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the service ID for a given service object if it exists in the container.

methods.name: recordContainer
methods.description: Records the current services in the container for serialization and cache purposes.

methods.name: generateServiceIdHash
methods.description: Creates a unique hash for a service object based on its class and object hash.
